title: Amelia | Relaxed V-Neck Shirt
bodyHtml:
That shirt you reach for when the weather starts warming up and you want to look put-together without any fuss. Our relaxed long shirt is cut to skim without clinging, with a gentle drape that feels like your second skin. Slip it on and your outfit is sorted—whether you're popping out or heading somewhere special, you'll feel confident and effortlessly polished.

Why you'll love it

  • Soft, lightweight fabric that moves beautifully and won't weigh you down on warmer days
  • Longer cut designed to sit comfortably over your middle without any tugging or pulling
  • Relaxed fit that skims your shape and lets you breathe all day long
  • Versatile V-neckline that works year-round with everything already in your wardrobe
  • Effortless elegance—no second-guessing yourself in the mirror
  • That one shirt you'll wear again and again because it just *works*

Over 50,000 women have already chosen us, with an average rating of 4.8 out of 5. Your happiness and your trust mean everything to us.
